source.publication: 2025 Complete Income Tax Instruction Booklet (ip25), Kansas Department of Revenue, with Form K-40 and Schedule S bound in (PDF pages 19-22)
source.section: Form K-40 lines 1-12 (ip25 PDF page 20; exemption block PDF page 19); K-40 instructions lines 1-3 (PDF page 6), line 4 and exemptions (PDF page 6), lines 5-8 (PDF page 7); tax rate schedule: 2025 Tax Computation Worksheet (PDF page 34) and Tax Table (PDF pages 27-34)

worked: Federal AGI = wages (you) 45,000.00 = 45,000.00. Federal taxable income = 45,000.00 - standard deduction 23,625.00 (23,625.00) = 21,375.00 (federal senior deduction ignored; federal figures are given, not tested; Kansas starts from federal AGI). No Kansas modifications: Schedule S lines A9 and A26 are 0.00, line A27 net modification 0.00 (the K-40 instructions let a filer skip line 2). Form K-40: line 1 federal AGI 45,000.00; line 2 modifications 0.00; line 3 Kansas AGI = 45,000.00 + (0.00) = 45,000.00; line 4 standard deduction (head of household) 6,180.00; line 5 exemption allowance 9,160.00 + head of household additional exemption 2,320.00 = 11,480.00, 0 dependents; line 6 total deductions = 6,180.00 + 11,480.00 = 17,660.00; line 7 taxable income = 45,000.00 - 17,660.00 = 27,340.00; line 8 tax (rate schedule as numbers, PDF page 34): 5.2% x 23,000.00 = 1,196.00 + 5.58% x (27,340.00 - 23,000.00 = 4,340.00) = 242.1720; total 1,438.1720 = 1,438.17. Line 7 is 100,000 or less, so the form reads the tax table: row 27,301-27,350, single, head of household or married filing separate column, PDF page 29, gives 1,437; expected keeps the formula figure. Lines 9-10 do not apply (resident); line 11 0.00; line 12 total income tax 1,438.17. Credits (lines 13-15, 17): none, 0.00; state income tax = 1,438.17. The projection folds the 2,320.00 additional head of household exemption into one return amount of 11,480.00 (PDF page 3 filing threshold: 17,660 = 6,180 + 11,480). The inputs carry no dependents, so none is claimed here; a real head of household return would add 2,320.00 per dependent, which the projection does not apply.
accepted_approximations: The blind amount, dependent exemptions and disabled veteran exemption are not applied (not_modelled).
Tax is computed from the rates, not the printed tables and rounded worksheet subtraction.
